error_direction_rationale: The kernel is an exact recomputation over borrower-supplied values with a symmetric 0.01 rounding tolerance on statement-line comparison; it adds no one-sided approximation of its own and every threshold (cushion cap, $50 refund floor, one-month shortage trigger) is taken verbatim from the cited rule text. The honest direction for an exact recompute with a symmetric tolerance is undirected.

derived_from.clause_path: 12 CFR 1024.17(c)(1)(i), (c)(4)-(5), (d)(1)-(2) -- escrow account analysis method: aggregate accounting, cushion cap, trial running balance, lowest monthly target balance
12 CFR 1024.17(f)(1)-(5) -- shortage, surplus, deficiency remedies; $50 surplus refund; 12-month shortage spread

branches.branch: The servicer first projects a trial balance for the account as a whole over the next computation year (a trial running balance), assuming estimated disbursements on their deadline dates and monthly borrower payments.
branches.note: compute() reproduces exactly this arithmetic from the stated opening balance, stated monthly deposit values, and stated disbursement values; the schedule is emitted month-by-month in output_payload.recomputed_balances.

branches.branch: The trial balance assumes disbursements are made on or before the earlier of the discount deadline or the penalty-avoidance deadline, and that pre-accrual is not used on these disbursement dates.

assumption_of_use.value: monthly disbursement values as stated on the servicer statement
assumption_of_use.owner: the caller, who reads the as-stated disbursement schedule off the statement

branches.note: Values-only contract: dates are not accepted as inputs at all, so timing conformance cannot be computed and is not silently assumed.

branches.branch: The servicer examines the monthly trial balances, adds an amount just sufficient to bring the lowest monthly balance to zero, adjusts all other months, and then adds the permissible cushion (two months of the borrower's escrow payments or a lesser amount under state law or the mortgage document).
branches.note: Classification against the target low point is algebraically equivalent to comparing the recomputed schedule against the zero-adjusted-plus-cushion target schedule: spread_vs_target == (low point) - (target low point), emitted as target_low_point plus the shortage_amount/surplus_amount members.

branches.branch: The permissible cushion is two months of the borrower's escrow payments, or a lesser amount specified by state law or the mortgage document.

assumption_of_use.value: the servicer stated cushion, in dollars
assumption_of_use.source: policy_parameters.stated_cushion, read off the servicer statement
assumption_of_use.owner: the caller, who supplies the governing cushion actually stated; the kernel never assumes a two-month default

branches.note: Values-only contract: the governing document is outside the kernel's inputs by construction.

branches.branch: The lowest monthly target balance must be less than or equal to one-sixth of the estimated total annual escrow account disbursements; the cushion must be no greater than one-sixth.
branches.note: output_payload.cushion_cap_amount carries the one-sixth cap computed from the stated disbursement values; a stated cushion above the cap fires CUSHION_ABOVE_STATUTORY_CAP and sets cushion_within_cap=false. Reachable conformance fixture: stated-cushion-above-cap.

branches.branch: All servicers must use the aggregate accounting method in conducting escrow account analyses.
branches.note: The kernel IS the aggregate accounting method re-implemented over values (output_payload.evidence.method names it); it cannot detect a servicer who used single-item analysis except insofar as that produces balance values that disagree line-by-line, which the discrepancy detector flags.

branches.branch: An escrow account analysis must be conducted at account creation and at completion of each computation year, and monthly deposits may not exceed one-twelfth of estimated total annual payments plus permitted amounts.
branches.note: The kernel audits one bounded computation year of statement VALUES; it cannot observe when analyses were conducted or whether a filing year boundary was skipped. No runtime path exists on values-only inputs. Declared gap: an audit reported clean says nothing about analysis-timing compliance -- a true timing violation is always missed, never falsely reported.

branches.branch: The cushion cap and analysis obligations sit inside an escrow regime with carve-outs (e.g. escrowed-MSA states, tax-sale scenarios) that this node's description declares out of scope.

assumption_of_use.value: that the loan sits inside the covered escrow regime (no escrowed-MSA state, no tax-sale scenario)
assumption_of_use.source: the caller regime determination, made before invoking the node
assumption_of_use.owner: the caller; the node refuses free-text regime facts as identifier-like fields and computes nothing for out-of-regime loans

branches.note: The caller owns determining that the loan is inside the covered escrow regime before feeding statement values; the node description declares the exclusions and the values-only refusal rejects any text value that would otherwise smuggle in regime facts.

branches.branch: The servicer must examine the mortgage loan documents; where the documents or state law require a lower cushion or none, the lower amount governs.

assumption_of_use.value: the governing cushion from the mortgage documents/state law as stated
assumption_of_use.owner: the caller, who reads the governing document; the kernel only caps the value at one-sixth, never raises it

branches.branch: If the analysis discloses a surplus, the servicer must refund the surplus within 30 days of the analysis; a surplus of $50 or more is within the mandatory-refund band.
branches.note: surplus_amount carries the disclosed surplus; surplus_refund_required is true when it meets the $50 floor and currency is established. Conformance fixture: worked-example-clean-year (balanced counter-case) and the reachability vector surplus-currency-unverified-reaches-hold for the conditioned branch.

branches.branch: The surplus provisions apply only if the borrower is current at the time of the escrow account analysis.

For a shortage below one month's payment the servicer may keep it, collect within 30 days, or spread over at least 12 months; at one month or more the servicer may allow it or require repayment in equal monthly payments over at least 12 months. Every course is permissive.
branches.note: shortage_amount carries the amount; shortage_permitted_courses carries the set of courses the rule permits (never a mandatory spread), thresholded on one month's escrow account payment (shortage_threshold_base, from monthly_escrow_payment or the mean of monthly_payments; shortage_repay_min_months_if_elected names the 12-month floor). WHICH course the servicer elects is the servicer's choice; when servicer_chosen_course is supplied the kernel reports servicer_course_permitted. Reachable fixtures: shortage-below-one-month-payment, shortage-at-one-month-payment, shortage-above-one-month-payment, shortage-servicer-30-day-course-not-permitted-at-threshold.

branches.branch: If the analysis confirms a deficiency (negative balance), the servicer may require additional monthly deposits; the remedy election again belongs to the servicer.
branches.note: A negative recomputed low point sets account_status='deficiency', ESCROW_DEFICIENCY, and shortage_amount to the size of the negative low point; the remedy election is out of scope for values. No conformance fixture drives a negative balance in the committed vectors, but the property floor's random corpus covers negative-opening statements.

branches.branch: The servicer shall notify the borrower at least once during the computation year if there is a shortage or deficiency.
branches.note: Notice conduct is not a statement value and has no runtime path on values-only inputs. Declared gap: the kernel can compute that a shortage exists (which is the notice's content) but can never verify that the notice was sent -- a true notice violation is always missed, never falsely reported.

branches.clause: AUTHORING-STANDARD section 1 (values-only contract); 12 CFR 1024.17 statement fields
branches.branch: A value-only statement carries numbers; a string value in any declared field (opening balance, cushion, monthly payment/disbursement/balance arrays) is identifier-like or free text by construction and is outside the values-only contract.
branches.note: The declared fields are type-checked BEFORE numeric coercion; the refused value is located (refused_field names the slot) and never echoed.

branches.branch: The escrow account computation year bounds the analysis period; this kernel is bounded to 12 monthly periods and refuses more.
